releases.title: Organize everything: file mobility, favorites, notebook folders

sections.title: New
entries: Move and copy files and folders between drives: cut or copy a selection, switch drives, and paste there — name clashes are renamed automatically and read-only (mirror) drives refuse the operation.
New Copy button and right-click Copy on files and folders; toolbar badge, menus and toasts show whether the clipboard holds a move or a copy.
Two new AI tools, move_files and copy_files: ask the chat to reorganize files across drives, with live progress chips like every other tool.
New automation node 'Move file to drive' (the Copy node also learned an optional destination folder); both refuse read-only drives.
Move/copy automation nodes now also take whole folders (new 'Folder from drive' input node): moving a folder relocates its entire tree with the descend-into-itself guard.

Favorites for personas and behaviors: star any Agency persona or your own behavior (Behaviors page or picker), and a ★ Favorites group pins them at the top of the chat persona picker; your behaviors can now be picked in the chat like personas, and starred ones sort first in the Automation behavior dropdown.

Notebook organize: every drive gets a 'DocIndex Notebooks' folder (book icon, backfilled for old drives) where new notebooks land by default; the Notebooks page groups cards by drive and folder in collapsible sections that remember their state, and offers Organize (previewed plan, explicit Confirm — never silent) plus Revert last organize, with the plan persisted so it survives restarts; automation notebook pickers group by folder.

Shared sync drives (two-way): point a drive at a Dropbox/OneDrive-style folder and edit both ways — local writes go through with history, remote changes are kept as versions (collapsed: what you saw + current), notebooks get an opt-in sticky full-history mode with embedded history, and corrupt remote files are quarantined instead of adopted.
Static background option in Profile → Appearance (next to the theme switch): flat background with no animation, easier on screen-sharing codecs.

Drives now have a trash bin: deleting a drive moves it — and every file in it — to the trash, and restoring brings the files back (files trashed earlier stay trashed). Synced drives skip the trash and are removed immediately. Purge deletes everything permanently; an opt-in 30-day auto-purge (now a prominent panel) cleans old trash.

sections.title: Improved
entries: Profile page reorganized (account, display, behaviors, AI usage, indexing queue, drives, trash, logs, admin); drive groups and cards are collapsible with memory, and the indexing queue card hides itself when idle.
Drive cards redesigned: stat tiles, copy-path button, collapsible sync options with worker pills, and a live progress bar while syncing.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Restoring a file whose drive is still trashed no longer strands it in limbo: a choice page asks whether to restore the original drive too or put the file in another drive.
Favorite stars were invisible (invalid icon class) on the Behaviors page and chat pickers — now a proper outline/solid star.

releases.title: Live background work: animated tools, run widgets, smarter tasks
releases.warning: The Automation module is still young — review a workflow's first runs before trusting it with important files.

sections.title: New
entries: Chat shows live tool-call chips: spinning icon, present-tense label ('Searching files…'), elapsed timer and step k/N progress, settling to a green check with the result summary.
Tool results now carry clickable file chips that open the referenced files; every message has a copy button and the last answer can be regenerated.

Automation background-runs widget (bottom-right, like sync): live progress of manual, scheduled and AI-triggered runs on any page, with stop button and finished toasts — the editor Run button now stays on the canvas.

Background tasks: dock icons show live step count, current tool and elapsed time, plus completion toasts and opt-in browser notifications; tasks can be renamed and re-run with the same question and context; queued tasks show their line position.
Chat history filter: All / Background tasks with status dots, launch toast listing the captured context, and finished banners reporting steps, duration and model.
Background mode now continues the same conversation — one chat can own several sequential tasks, keeping the whole history.

Attach files from your device straight in the chat (paperclip or drag & drop): saved to the open drive, or to a drive you pick when it is read-only — images land with caption + thumbnail, tables with columns and head rows, text with word counts, and sending waits for the summary.
Every attachment chip has a 'Run workflow' button for workflows that accept files; attached content is also pre-summarized into the AI context so answers come without extra tool calls.
New view_image tool: the AI looks at images through the vision model (optionally focused by your question) instead of relying on the short stored caption — and refreshes that caption for search.

Semantic search (opt-in): hybrid keyword + meaning retrieval with RRF fusion, Keywords/Hybrid/Meaning toggle on the results page, 'Similar files' on the file view, embeddings stored per chunk — enable with AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL globally or per AI connection, then backfill with reindex-embeddings.
Template fan-in: connect several nodes into a transform.template input and join them all with {{ in }}.

sections.title: Improved
entries: Automations list: proper toolbar layout, single search box, and styles that survive first load and SPA navigation.
Task workers answer the question that launched them with the recent transcript attached, instead of the conversation's first message.
Deleting a conversation also removes its background tasks, so the dock never points at a deleted transcript.
Conversation detail exposes task start/finish times; run progress computation is shared between the run page and the widget feed.
Notebooks (.pdocnb) get their own amber book icon in the drive, search results and chat attachments instead of the generic file.

AI connection form splits essentials from an Advanced disclosure (budgets, limits, history); Run-workflow pickers match the automations list (status, time, folders) and disambiguate same-name workflows.
Avatar uses local gradient initials (no external image service); profile crash on drives with files fixed.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Automation editor canvas stayed empty due to a stray brace breaking the editor script.
Whole app rendered unstyled after privacy attributes were added to the Tailwind CDN tag — reverted.
Double search box on the automations page caused by the legacy input styling.
Run status endpoint refactored with identical output; re-run of old tasks falls back to the first user message.

releases.title: Automation grows up: folders, smarter nodes, live preview
releases.warning: The Automation module is still young — review a workflow's first runs before trusting it with important files.

sections.title: New
entries: Organize automations in a folder tree with search, drag & drop, right-click actions (Windows-style menu), inline rename, and one-click cleanup of empty folders — the AI can organize too (create/move/list).
New Drive input node: the workflow can ask which drive to use when it runs (run form or AI), and any Drive field accepts {{ nX }} references to it.
New data nodes: multi-key table join, table union (distinct/all), table minus, table pivot, HTTP fetch, text splitter, folder listing and file copy.
Conditions now support several AND/OR comparisons in one node, with the legacy single comparison kept working.
Notebook inputs can now read one specific cell instead of the whole notebook.
validate_workflow: the AI checks a workflow without running it — every problem, field and fix hint up front; failed runs explain what to fix.
Live preview animations: wires flow while a preview runs, nodes light up green/red in execution order, and the run page has an animated progress bar.
A 'What's new' page (this one) is linked from the user menu with the running version.

sections.title: Improved
entries: Node settings popups redesigned: only essential fields up front, the rest under Advanced, required badges, one-click Try examples, readable help, and Done validates before closing.
Node cards redesigned with status dots, kind labels and Yes/No branch chips; bigger touch-friendly sockets.
The automations page fits on screen: compact header, dismissible notice, internal scrolling lists and a full-width canvas editor on mobile.
API keys for AI connections are now stored encrypted; session cookies hardened (HttpOnly, SameSite).
Markdown from files and AI answers is sanitized before display; image captions are downscaled before upload.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Fresh installs no longer fail on the automation migrations (missing users table) and recover cleanly from interrupted startups.
Searching '*' no longer crashes the AI agent; database-is-locked contention is retried with backoff.
Canvas wires no longer appear detached when an automation is first opened — they redraw until the layout settles.
The node settings Cancel button always closes the popup, even if the editor script hasn't finished wiring it.
Duplicate-workflow badge shows in both grid and list views.

releases.title: Automation, behaviors & personas
releases.warning: The Automation module is in a very early stage — use it with care. Workflows may misbehave, node configs may change between releases, and runs can fail midway. Keep a copy of anything important before letting a workflow modify it.

sections.title: New
entries: Automation module: visual workflow editor with input, AI, transform, logic and output nodes — build pipelines by dragging nodes on a canvas.
Workflow runs: live run page with progress bar, per-node output popups, execution console, durations (ms/s/m/h) and an inputs & outputs reference section.

Behaviors & personas are now a core feature: manage reusable AI instructions on the Behaviors page (Profile → Behaviors & personas), including the bundled Agency persona library with per-persona and per-division enable/disable toggles.
Chat: the workflow open in the Automation editor appears as a context chip (like the current file), so the AI can inspect and edit it directly.
Chat: background tasks now stream live in the chat that launched them — no need to close and reopen the window.
Drive: rubber-band (lasso) selection — drag from empty space to select many files and folders at once (hold Ctrl/Cmd to add to the selection).

sections.title: Improved
entries: Chat context chips now refresh automatically when you navigate, so they always match what is on screen.
Automation index reorganized: collapsible examples, your workflows, and recent runs with status.
Persona previews render as formatted markdown instead of raw text.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Drive: multi-select, drag & drop and right-click menus broke after the first page navigation — the page script now survives SPA navigation.
Indexing: 'database is locked' errors under parallel sync workers are retried instead of crashing the job.
Chat: the AI can use Automation tools again when the module is enabled (namespaced tools were invisible to the model).

sections.title: New
entries: Trash bin: deleted files land in the trash and can be restored or purged from the profile page.
Long-horizon background AI tasks with a dock widget, stop button and per-task event stream.
File version history: uploading or editing creates versions, with text diffs and one-click restore.

sections.title: New
entries: Personal searchable file drive: upload, OCR, full-text search and AI chat over your own files.
Multiple drives, folders, hashtags, duplicate detection and synced (read-only) local folders.
Docker and local install scripts, install guide and first-admin-user creation.
